subject: Heliotrope SIG: evidence staging, redaction guidance & delegated collector runbook
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@heliotrope.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@heliotrope.com>, Jake Morales <jmorales@heliotrope.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire — initial evidence requests and PII redaction question

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on accepting our SIG packet. To move forward we need a short plan for how Redwood will stage and hand off control evidence for the following items (examples pulled from our SIG matrix):

- AC-2: user provisioning and deprovisioning proof (change logs, ticket references)
- AU-3 / SRV-LOGS: sample access logs (with time window and explanation of log retention policy)
- CM-3: configuration baselines for your hosted and private deployment variants
- KC-1: key management overview and KMS proof-of-rotation artifacts
- CC-6: third-party processor contracts (we need attestations and redlines if applicable)

Two specific asks up-front:
1) We will need a redaction approach: what fields you will redact vs provide as metadata (e.g., user IDs vs emails). Are you able to provide a redaction runbook and a small sample (sanitized) log showing the format?
2) Timeline: can you stage a partial packet (high-value items) by EOD 2027-09-06 and the remainder within 10 business days?

Also — please confirm if any artifacts will require an NDA or data-sharing agreement prior to delivery.

Appreciate it,
Lena Ortiz
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager — Heliotrope Financial
lena.ortiz@heliotrope.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments referenced: Helio_SIG_RFI_v2.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodai.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@heliotrope.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — initial evidence requests and PII redaction question

Team —

Forwarding Helio's asks. I propose we follow a two-track evidence handoff to meet their mid-week ask and minimize rework:

Track A (by 2027-09-06 EOD):
- High-value artifacts: SOC 2 Type II summary, ISO 27001 certificate (if available), access control change logs for the last 90 days (sanitized), and a redaction runbook draft.
- Deliverables staged to a Helio-shared Drive folder (link to be provided) with a README describing redaction decisions.

Track B (within 10 business days):
- Deeper artifacts: full config snapshots (redacted), KMS rotation proof (signed export), third-party contracts matrix and relevant redlines, and sample deployment manifests for Redwood Private.

Owners: Kimberly — lead artifact collection and redaction; Priyom — artifact inventory and evidence mapping (SIG csv); Karthik — KMS/key rotation and infra config pieces. I will coordinate comms with Helio and handle executive escalations.

Redaction: we will produce a short runbook that specifies which fields are redacted vs hashed vs replaced by placeholders. The runbook will include a brief script pattern for log redaction and a small sanitized sample. Approved fields: full timestamps, hashed unique IDs; redact email addresses and IPs unless required with NDA.

Please prepare: artifact_inventory.csv (schema below) and a first-pass redaction_runbook.md. Kimberly — can you attach the staging Drive link and a sample access log dump (sanitized) by tomorrow?

Marcus
Head of Product Security, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodai.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodai.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@heliotrope.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — initial evidence requests and PII redaction question

On Wed, Sep 1, 2027 at 9:15 AM Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@heliotrope.com> wrote:
> Marcus —
>
> Thanks for the quick turnaround on accepting our SIG packet. To move forward we need a short plan for how Redwood will stage and hand off control evidence for the following items...

Hi Lena —

Thanks — we created a Helio-staging folder and uploaded the partial packet identified in Track A. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GkZ-Helio-evidence-staging

What you'll find in the folder now (partial):
- artifact_inventory.csv (CSV listing control, artifact filename, owner, redaction status)
- redaction_runbook.md (policy + example sed/py filter snippets)
- sample_access_logs.txt (sanitized — timestamps preserved; PII hashed)
- permission_matrix.pdf (high-level RBAC snapshot for hosted and private offerings)

Notes on redaction approach:
- Email addresses -> replaced with [REDACTED_EMAIL] and a hashed id in parenthesis (sha256).
- IP addresses -> suppressed unless explicitly requested under NDA; we will provide ASN ranges if helpful.
- User IDs -> show stable hashed identifier so sequences can be validated without exposing real IDs.

NDA: we reviewed Helio's standard vendor NDA link and don't believe an additional execution is required for the artifacts in Track A. For logs or anything containing IP telemetry we will request Helio sign the mutual NDA before delivery.

Next steps:
- We will add KMS rotation proof and the third-party contract crosswalk to the same folder by 2027-09-06 EOD.
- Priyom will attach the SIG control crosswalk (CSV) to the folder tomorrow.

Attachments: artifact_inventory.csv, redaction_runbook.md, sample_access_logs.txt, permission_matrix.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodai.com
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@heliotrope.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodai.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Jake Morales <jmorales@heliotrope.com>, Procurement <procurement@heliotrope.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — initial evidence requests and PII redaction question

Kimberly / Marcus —

Thanks — I can confirm we have downloaded the partial packet and reviewed the redaction_runbook. A few clarifications before we proceed to Track B:

- CC-6 third-party processor evidence: please surface the contract summary page for the three named processors listed in your inventory (anonymized names are fine if there are NDAs) and the contract effective dates. We also need an internal attestation that these vendors are scoped into your SOC 2 assessment.
- KMS rotation proof: a signed export showing rotation events with timestamps is acceptable; please remove raw key material (obvious) and include the signing key reference for verification.
- On-prem offering: we need a short statement on whether any difference in control effectiveness exists for Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem). A sentence or two is fine — we will escalate internally if we need deeper evidence.

Also — we may need Helio legal to execute the simple mutual NDA for the telemetry logs. I'll have Procurement coordinate a DocuSign link (I see one in your related_links).

Can we schedule a 30-minute sync on Tue 2027-09-07 at 10:00 PT to walk through the folder and confirm next delivery windows? If that works I will send an invite.

Lena Ortiz
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager — Heliotrope Financial
